title: 雪隐山居 · 云岫山境

features.name: 栖月山庄
features.description: 归云谷内、藏月湖西侧的岸边山庄。

notes: 云岫山境：参考阿尔卑斯山群的分水岭、冰川槽谷和支谷层级重新设计的虚构地形，非实测 DEM。主脊与支脉不闭合；宽山肩连接峰体，五处高垭口；各湖设出流谷。底图通过边界优先泛洪检查并整理非预期洼地。 山系草案03：听雪峰、凝霜峰、照岚峰降低并收缩，外侧新增八座低峰，沿无环支脉分级展开，保留开放河谷与原有用户区域。 峰群草案03低峰微调：仅将八座低峰向内小幅移动，保留大峰及原有地貌，仅在低峰邻近范围变形衔接。 山水生态修订：保留全部河流流程并局部整修河床与等高线；主要闭合洼地形成湖盆；新增听雪瀑106m、藏月瀑85m、听松山庄及晴岚山庄。步道按坡度和水体寻路；植被按北纬32°日照、坡向、遮阴、海拔、坡度和相对湿度形成连续过渡。此为虚构地形设计，非实测生态或工程数据。 登山步道线形修订：以50%为最大纵坡，普通爬升与等高线交角不超过45°，垭口650m接近段不超过60°；删除缓坡偏好造成的密集折返，连接点固定，采用受地形约束的捷径和平顺转角。 步道曲线编辑修订：编辑点与内部高程采样分离，使用三次贝塞尔曲线、少量通过点和方向手柄；保留支路交点和功能入口，二维、三维及世界导出共用曲线。

ecology.method: 12 representative solar days × 5 solar hours; slope normal and terrain horizon across the 20 × 16 km map; moisture and slope transitions
ecology.speciesStatus: functional art palette for a fictional mountain at 32°N; not a verified local flora survey

generationRules.density: use continuous tree/shrub/grass fractions per cell, blend neighboring cells
generationRules.species: blend community palettes by elevation, sun exposure, moisture; no hard altitude bands
generationRules.trees: reduce height and canopy closure near the forest line; warmer slopes reach a relatively higher line
generationRules.snow: shaded high slopes retain more snow; exclude permanent snow and cliffs

trailNetwork.routeMethod: distance-led mountain trail tree; hard 50% grade, 45/60 degree contour angle; protected junctions, line-of-sight shortcuts and terrain-checked corner rounding
trailNetwork.designStatus: virtual mountain footpaths; terrain constraints use the current 50 m bilinear height field
trailNetwork.geometry: cubic-bezier; editable knots and handles, transient internal sampling

summitRepair.method: local single summit and boundary-following shoulders; unchanged outside repair disks
